he.text: אָשַׁמְנוּ · בָּגַדְנוּ · גָּזַלְנוּ · דִּבַּרְנוּ דֹפִי · הֶעֱוִינוּ · וְהִרְשַׁעְנוּ׃ זַדְנוּ · חָמַסְנוּ · טָפַלְנוּ שֶׁקֶר · יָעַצְנוּ רָע · כִּזַּבְנוּ · לַצְנוּ · מָרַדְנוּ · נִאַצְנוּ · סָרַרְנוּ · עָוִינוּ · פָּשַׁעְנוּ · צָרַרְנוּ · קִשִּׁינוּ עֹרֶף · רָשַׁעְנוּ׃ שִׁחַתְנוּ · תִּעַבְנוּ · תָּעִינוּ · תִּעְתָּעְנוּ׃ סַרְנוּ מִמִּצְוֹתֶיךָ וּמִמִּשְׁפָּטֶיךָ הַטּוֹבִים · וְלֹא שָׁוָה לָנוּ׃

en.text: We have trespassed, we have dealt treacherously, we have stolen, we have spoken slander, we have committed iniquity, and have done wickedly, we have acted presumptuously, we have committed violence, we have framed falsehood, we have counselled evil, we have uttered lies, we have scorned, we have rebelled, we have blasphemed, we have revolted, we have acted perversely, we have transgressed, we have oppressed, we have been stiffnecked, we have acted wickedly, we have corrupted, we have done abominably, we have gone astray we and have caused others to err; we have turned aside from thy excellent

he.text: וְאַתָּה צַדִּיק עַל כָּל הַבָּא עָלֵינוּ · כִּי אֱמֶת עָשִׂיתָ וַאֲנַחְנוּ הִרְשָׁעְנוּ׃

en.text: precepts and institutions, and which hath not profited us: but thou art just concerning all that is come upon us; for thou hast dealt most truly, but we have done wickedly.
